entities.name: Theodor Homén
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Viktor Theodor Homén was a Finnish physicist and politician. He was a member of the Diet of Finland from 1905 to 1906 and of the Parliament of Finland from 1908 to 1913, representing the Young Finnish Party and again from 1919 to 1922, representing the National Coalition Party.
